code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    rows={r for r,c in pts if c in (0,w-1) and (r,0) in pts and (r,w-1) in pts}
    cols={c for r,c in pts if r in (0,h-1) and (0,c) in pts and (h-1,c) in pts}
    for r in rows:
        for c in range(w): out[r][c]=1
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h): out[r][c]=1
    return out
'''
